summary_rationale: Netweb Technologies is a genuinely profitable, fast-growing Indian high-end computing OEM with a narrow but real qualification-and-integration moat. Revenue compounded at roughly 50% a year for eight years to ₹2,184 crore in FY2026 (and ₹2,143 crore in H1 FY27); operating margin has held at 13–15% even as scale multiplied; ROCE of 37.5% and ROE of 32.8% comfortably exceed an estimated 12–14% cost of capital; net cash stands at ₹13.6 crore with ₹425.6 crore of unutilised QIP proceeds and CRISIL A+/Stable credit rating; and the confirmed order book of ₹2,629 crore rose even after ₹2,143 crore of H1 FY27 billing. It remains classified CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL rather than COMPOUNDER_PASS for four evidence-based reasons reinforced by the November 2026 forensic audit. First, cash conversion and financing friction are material: from FY2021 to FY2025 cumulative operating profit of ₹381 crore (and ₹267 crore of net profit) generated only ~₹27 crore of operating cash flow; ₹766.7 crore (~64%) of the August 2026 ₹1,200 crore QIP was absorbed into working capital within 40 days; CRISIL expanded rated bank facilities 3.46x to ₹2,420 crore (including ₹270 crore non-fund/BG limits); and quarterly finance costs surged 26x YoY to ₹23.8 crore in Q2 FY27 (₹46 crore TTM). Second, dual concentration is high: CRISIL (June 2026) flags that top-5 customers contribute 65–70% of revenue and top-3 suppliers account for 65–70% of procurement, with heavy Taiwan import reliance and ~40% of import payables unhedged for FX. Third, AI systems now drive 58.4% of Q2 FY27 revenue, where 27 PLI 2.0 IT Hardware beneficiaries (including Dell, HP, Foxconn, Flextronics, Lenovo/Dixon, VVDN and Kaynes) narrow the domestic-manufacturing moat, and management's ₹4,000 crore FY27 target implies an H2 step-down to ₹1,857 crore (-13.3% HoH / +17.6% YoY). Fourth, promoter monetisation was substantial (3.65% / ₹514+ crore block sale in Feb 2026) with the 12-month no-dilution pledge expiring in Feb 2027. KPI health remains PASS_WITH_WATCH: order book, pipeline and margins are healthy, but inventory days (117), finance costs (₹23.8 Cr/quarter), QIP burn, and H2 order conversion require quarterly monitoring. No accounting-integrity red flag warrants a FUNDAMENTAL_FAIL.
